name: jsxmotion
description: Narrated videos written like apps: JSX scenes in Remotion, voiced by ElevenLabs, every frame on the spoken word. App guides, storyboard announcements and promos.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Used to record the voiceover. Kept in your system keychain. Optional: leave it empty to use a .env file instead.

voice_id.title: ElevenLabs voice ID
voice_id.description: The voice that narrates your videos. Optional: a project's own .env can set a different one, and Claude can find one for you.

voices.title: More voices (for dialogue)
voices.description: Optional. Voices you reuse for characters, as NAME=voice ID pairs separated by commas, for example HOST=abc123, GUEST=def456. A script uses them as VOICE_HOST and VOICE_GUEST. Claude can also cast fresh voices for each video.
